mechanism: Each stored orderblock is monitored: if a bullish OB’s low is broken by bid, mark violated and promote it as the active bearish mitigation block (direction flipped); if a bearish OB’s high is broken by ask, promote as bullish mitigation. Only the active mitigation OB may fire inverted entries when price re-enters the zone.
data_needed: Live bid/ask; list of COrderBlock with direction, high/low, violated flag; violation timestamp.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit structure-failure → polarity-flip sensor: invalidated institutional zones become opposite-bias mitigation levels rather than discarded noise.
quote: Once a violation is detected, the system updates the order block’s status, marks the violation time, and resets any active mitigation block references before reassigning the violated block as the new active mitigation order block with an opposite directional bias.

mechanism: Within Time1Hstrt–Time1Hend hours, once per calendar day, scan bars for bullish OB = bearish candle followed by two bullish closes (accumulation at swing low) or bearish OB = bullish candle followed by two bearish closes (distribution). Store high/low of the impulse-origin candle as the zone.
data_needed: OHLC of recent bars; session hour window; daily prevDay gate.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: H1 backtest window; session filter defaults Time1Hstrt=1, Time1Hend=10
why_new_for_mis: Simple, session-constrained OB origin sensor MIS can use as liquidity-shelf candidates before violation/mitigation logic.
quote: The function first checks for bullish order block conditions—where a bearish candle is followed by two consecutive bullish candles—indicating potential accumulation and a shift in market sentiment.

mechanism: CBEOMonitor canvas class for EA-specific on-chart logging, tick timing, and Experts-tab dual output. Debugging/UI infrastructure only; no market regime or sensing feature is built.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo on USDCHF H1 / EURUSD; not a market sensor
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—EA backend diagnostics UI only.
quote: By building a class specifically for backend operations, developers gain; A clean, EA-specific debugging interface.

mechanism: IsSwingHigh/IsSwingLow require MinSwingBars neighbors on both sides strictly below/above the candidate by MinSwingDistance×_Point. DetectSwing scans recent bars and tags wick or body extreme; ManageTradingLogic alternates lookingForHigh/lookingForLow and fires buy on new swing low / sell on new swing high.
data_needed: OHLC series; MinSwingBars; MinSwingDistance in points; optional UseWickForTrade.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol (gold/forex/indices cited); backtest 2H, 08 Apr 2025–29 Jul 2025
why_new_for_mis: Noise-filtered swing-turn sensor with explicit distance threshold—MIS can stream structural turning events without tiny wobbles.
quote: If any of those nearby highs are within the defined MinSwingDistance, the bar is disqualified as a swing high because the price action around it isn’t distinct enough.

mechanism: CopyTime/CopyOpen/CopyClose of InpHigherTF; for each HTF bar draw vertical period markers plus optional bullish/bearish body rectangles and open/close horizontals on the lower-TF chart. Visible-range filter (CHART_FIRST_VISIBLE_BAR/WIDTH) limits object creation. Minors placed strictly between consecutive majors.
data_needed: HTF OHLC via CopyTime/Open/Close; lookback; major/minor TF inputs; chart visible window.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Configurable major TF (default H1) and minors (M30/M15) drawn on any lower chart TF (M1/M5 stressed for performance)
why_new_for_mis: Turns HTF candle geometry into an on-LTF structural overlay sensor—MIS can align LTF features to HTF period boundaries and body polarity.
quote: The tool visually synchronizes higher-timeframe boundaries within lower-timeframe charts, enabling traders to study detailed intra-period price action while maintaining context from the higher timeframe.

mechanism: For each HTF major bar compute body_top=max(open,close), body_bot=min(open,close). If high>body_top draw semi-transparent upper-wick rectangle HTF_MAJ_W_U_*; if low<body_bot draw lower-wick rectangle. Toggle g_ShowWicks; alpha-blended overlays isolate rejection/liquidity extents of HTF shadows on the LTF chart.
data_needed: HTF open/high/low/close; PeriodSeconds for rectangle end; wick alpha; keepNames GC list.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Primary HTF e.g. H1 on M5/M15 live charts; example visualizes H1 wick anatomy on M1
why_new_for_mis: Explicit HTF wick-as-liquidity/rejection-zone sensor—MIS can treat upper/lower shadow fills as mapped rejection territories rather than leftover chart chrome.
quote: Filling the wick extents isolates rejection/liquidity zones visually… What appeared as a single rejection tail in A unfolds into a detailed pattern of micro-support formations.

mechanism: MVC table UI: sortable columns via ASC/DESC index offsets, resizable captions, CTableControl helpers. Controls/library article only; no market sensing.

mechanism: For each D1 close, recompute T to fixed expiry, then BS_DeltaCall = e^{-qT} N(d1) and BS_Gamma = N'(d1) e^{-qT}/(S σ √T). Export Date/Close/Delta/Gamma CSV; risk bands classify high/moderate/low Delta and Gamma. Gamma peaks nearer strike; Delta→1 deep ITM.
data_needed: Daily closes; K, σ, r, q; expiry datetime; BarsToCalc.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EU50 (EU50 index) PERIOD_D1; strike 5000; Dec 31 2025 expiry; σ=16.91%
why_new_for_mis: Provides MIS a path of option convexity/directional sensitivity vs spot—Gamma as near-strike vol-sensitivity sensor, Delta as moneyness/exposure sensor.
quote: Gamma peaks around the strike price, meaning Delta changes fastest there. As price moves far away from the strike, Gamma fades to near zero.

mechanism: FindSwingPoints tags bars higher/lower than two neighbors each side within MaxBarsBack; trendDirection = swingHighIndex > swingLowIndex. In uptrend entry = swingHigh − range×0.618 with target further −range×1.0 (sell retracement); in downtrend mirror buy at swingLow+range×0.618. Draws prediction/target pathways and optional pending orders.
data_needed: OHLC swing window; TradingRetracementLevel (0.618); ProfitTargetLevel (≥1); MaxBarsBack.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Tested GBPUSD M1; suggested EURUSD/GBPUSD H1/H4
why_new_for_mis: Packages swing-defined trend regime with golden-ratio retracement pathway as a single anticipatory level sensor for MIS.
quote: Instead of merely marking where price might reverse, we're building an Expert Advisor that visualizes the entire trade journey—from the expected retracement entry through the projected extension target.

mechanism: CalculateDynamicFrequency: if Gamma > 2×GammaThreshold check every 1 min; if > threshold use base HedgeFrequency; else every 5 min. OnTick runs ExecuteCombinedStrategy only when elapsed ≥ currentHedgeFrequency minutes—monitoring cadence itself tracks convexity.
data_needed: Live BS Gamma from spot/K/σ/T/r/q; GammaThreshold; HedgeFrequency.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EU50cash H1; 14 Feb 2025–11 Apr 2025 backtest; Dec 2025 expiry
why_new_for_mis: Turns Gamma magnitude into a volatility-regime clock for MIS—high convexity ⇒ higher sensing frequency.
quote: High Gamma implies rapid changes in Delta, so the system increases monitoring to once per minute… while low Gamma relaxes the evaluation interval to five minutes.

mechanism: PortfolioDelta = net underlying lots + OptionPosition×currentDelta. ExecuteDeltaHedge fires when |portfolioDelta − 0| > DeltaThreshold, selling to cut positive delta or buying to cut negative. Separate ExecuteGammaStrategy buys/sells when Gamma high and price within 2% of strike with Delta>0.6/<0.4.
data_needed: Open positions on _Symbol; OptionPosition; currentDelta/Gamma; DeltaThreshold.
why_new_for_mis: Net portfolio-Delta residual is a continuous exposure/imbalance sensor MIS can use beyond single-option Greeks.
quote: When the portfolio's net delta deviates beyond a specified threshold from zero, the system will automatically execute trades in the underlying EU50 to rebalance back to delta neutrality.

mechanism: Bin lookback bars into profileBins price buckets with overlap+body-weighted volume. POC = max-volume bin; Value Area expands from POC preferring higher adjacent volume until VA_Percentage (70%); HVN = bins ≥ median×HVN_Threshold; LVN = bins ≤ median×LVN_Threshold (>0).
data_needed: OHLCV for VP_LookbackBars; VA_Percentage; HVN/LVN thresholds; ATR for stops.
why_new_for_mis: Full liquidity-architecture sensor stack (POC magnet, value envelope, acceptance/rejection nodes) built from distributed volume—not price alone.
quote: AVPT exposes the hidden layers of market memory—showing exactly where institutions agreed, disagreed, and positioned themselves.

mechanism: Reversion: near VAL + bullish rejection candle → buy SL at nearest LVN below, TP at POC; near VAH + bearish rejection → sell. Breakout: price > VAH with UP confirmation → buy SL nearest HVN below; price < VAL with DOWN confirmation → sell. Early exit if price re-enters Value Area.
data_needed: Current price vs valPrice/vahPrice/pocPrice; hvnLevels/lvnLevels; recent MqlRates for rejection/breakout confirms.
why_new_for_mis: Converts volume-profile geometry into discrete change events (boundary rejection vs LVN acceleration) for MIS event streams.
quote: Low-Volume Nodes function as acceleration zones where price can move rapidly due to the absence of meaningful trading interest.

mechanism: Sentiment from H4 EMA bias (|price−MA|/MA > ATRThreshold) plus H1/M30 HH-HL or LH-LL structure and breakouts: Strong Bull/Bear (1/−1) → BOS strategy; Risk-On/Off (2/−2) → FVG; Neutral (0) → Order Blocks. SelectTradingStrategy then runs only the matching SMC detector; ExecuteTradeWithFilter requires direction aligned with sentiment.
data_needed: iMA handles on H4/H1/M30; SwingLookback; ATRThreshold; AllowBOS/OB/FVG flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-TF H4+H1+M30 sentiment; backtest H1 01 Oct 2025–01 Dec 2025
why_new_for_mis: Explicit regime classifier that gates which structure sensor family is active—MIS can reuse the sentiment state as a strategy/regime switch feature.
quote: Based on calculated sentiment readings ranging from Strong Bullish to Strong Bearish, Risk-On to Risk-Off, and Neutral conditions, the EA dynamically selects and prioritizes the most appropriate SMC strategy.

mechanism: IsBullishStructure: recent swing high and low both higher than prior lookback window (HH+HL). IsBearishStructure: LL+LH. HasBreakout: close breaks lookback swing high if higherTFBias bullish, or swing low if bearish. These bits feed DetermineSentiment.
data_needed: iHighest/iLowest over lookback×2; close vs swing levels; higherTFBias ∈ {-1,0,1}.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Applied on LowerTF1=H1 and LowerTF2=M30 under HigherTF=H4
why_new_for_mis: Compact multi-TF structure/breakout boolean sensors MIS can consume independently of the full ASMA router.
quote: Bullish structure: Higher highs AND higher lows… Breakout in direction of higher timeframe bias.
